{"question":{"id":"q05","question":"苏天晴第一次变身是怎样触发的？喊变身词有反应吗？","readAt":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":66}},"mode":"source","remainingQueries":3,"answerRequired":false,"history":[{"requests":[{"command":"source","perspective":"reader","world":"original","limit":10,"chapter":2,"query":"变身"},{"command":"source","perspective":"reader","world":"original","limit":10,"chapter":2,"query":"苏天晴"},{"command":"source","perspective":"reader","world":"original","limit":10,"chapter":2,"from":1,"to":40}],"results":[{"schema":"neurobook.memory.query.v1","ok":true,"command":"source","snapshot":{"id":"llm-through-2","sourceManifest":"manifest:5f3e24ecdc495fd9","knowledgeRevision":2,"readAt":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":87},"contentHash":"e2fbce45f27fc3120348bb019db2e5a383d462324b773e238d4d4825b6c76891"},"scope":{"readAt":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":66},"perspective":"reader","world":"original"},"items":[{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":42,"text":"材质不明的金色十字星，做工蛮精致，手感扎实，不像是塑料玩具，这个应该就是魔法少女们必备的变身道具了吧。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":47,"text":"魔法少女变身！穿着华丽的洋装在城市间穿梭飞行与怪人战斗！这具身体的原主人也曾经梦想过这种场面！"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":50,"text":"“变……变身！”"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":52,"text":"嗯？不对吗？变身不是这么喊的？还是说要加点什么前缀？"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":53,"text":"“魔法少女变身！”"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":57,"text":"狐狐嗓子都快喊哑了，脑子里能想到的变身词全喊了一遍，却仍是没见手中这枚十字星有丁点动静。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":58,"text":"不是，你这秘典都不给点新手指引的吗，别人拿到系统多少都有个新手任务好伐，至少教我怎么变身嘛！"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":61,"text":"也没见这上面有写字呀，到底要怎么才能变身呢。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":66,"text":"【初次变身，已完成】"}],"coverage":{"through":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":66},"chapters":[1,2],"material":"complete","semantic":"partial","gaps":["未提供当前阅读范围与视角专属的语义缺口说明。"],"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false},"completeness":{"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false,"matchingRecords":9,"returned":9},"truncation":{"page":false,"depth":false,"unavailableReferences":0},"nextCursor":null},{"schema":"neurobook.memory.query.v1","ok":true,"command":"source","snapshot":{"id":"llm-through-2","sourceManifest":"manifest:5f3e24ecdc495fd9","knowledgeRevision":2,"readAt":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":87},"contentHash":"e2fbce45f27fc3120348bb019db2e5a383d462324b773e238d4d4825b6c76891"},"scope":{"readAt":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":66},"perspective":"reader","world":"original"},"items":[{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":6,"text":"吐掉嘴里的牙膏泡沫，苏天晴默默放下手中那只可爱的猫猫水杯与牙刷，双手撑住洗手池，抬起脑袋看向镜子里的金毛狐狐。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":17,"text":"与镜中的自己对视了半晌，苏天晴猛然察觉到自己这样的举动很像个变泰，脸颊微红，轻咳两声收敛发癫的状态，开始认真审视起自己身体中残留的记忆。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":18,"text":"这副身体的原主人就叫苏天晴，这里与自己曾经的世界相差无几，但却是人类与兽人共存的一个世界。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":20,"text":"虽然名义上共存，但兽人数量远远不及人类，苏天晴从小便独自一人孤独地长大，虽然模样可爱但社恐孤僻，好在有兽人互助协会的资助顺利考上蓉城最好的医学院，却又在临近开学时染上一场兽人流感，熬夜过程中突发了暴发性心肌炎……"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":23,"text":"想到这，苏天晴不由得感觉胸口幻痛，连忙伸手去揉了揉。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":25,"text":"简单洗漱了一遍，苏天晴踩着不合脚的大拖鞋走到客厅，一边躺上沙发，一边顺手从茶几上拿起刚才那本跟自己说话的古书。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":30,"text":"揣着一丝侥幸，苏天晴举起手中这本古书，翻开扉页。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":33,"text":"一枚金色十字星从书里掉出，狠狠砸在毫无防备的苏天晴脸上。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":46,"text":"把金色十字星拎在手里把玩了半晌，比起那个莫名其妙的秘典，苏天晴对这枚所谓的“守护之星”倒是更感兴趣，眼中甚至逐渐放出光彩。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":63,"text":"盯着十字星中间那枚刚好能容纳下一只手指的凹陷看了半晌，苏天晴试探着将拇指摁了进去。"}],"coverage":{"through":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":66},"chapters":[1,2],"material":"complete","semantic":"partial","gaps":["未提供当前阅读范围与视角专属的语义缺口说明。"],"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false},"completeness":{"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false,"matchingRecords":10,"returned":10},"truncation":{"page":false,"depth":false,"unavailableReferences":0},"nextCursor":null},{"schema":"neurobook.memory.query.v1","ok":true,"command":"source","snapshot":{"id":"llm-through-2","sourceManifest":"manifest:5f3e24ecdc495fd9","knowledgeRevision":2,"readAt":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":87},"contentHash":"e2fbce45f27fc3120348bb019db2e5a383d462324b773e238d4d4825b6c76891"},"scope":{"readAt":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":66},"perspective":"reader","world":"original"},"items":[{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":1,"text":"第2章 反派的日常就是找茬"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":2,"text":"严正声明：本书出场角色均已满18岁！不存在任何未成年人！"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":3,"text":"——————————"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":4,"text":"“哗啦啦啦——”"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":5,"text":"“哗呸！”"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":6,"text":"吐掉嘴里的牙膏泡沫，苏天晴默默放下手中那只可爱的猫猫水杯与牙刷，双手撑住洗手池，抬起脑袋看向镜子里的金毛狐狐。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":7,"text":"五官无可挑剔，精致可爱，毛发柔顺肌肤光滑，能从宽松睡衣的领口瞥见浅浅的河谷，那双不安中带着些许惊讶的眼眸更是摄人心魄，仿佛有着狐人生来便有的魅意。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":8,"text":"抛开那听起来就很离谱的反派魔法少女不谈，这副身体的模样还真是绝妙中的绝妙。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":9,"text":"每一个细节都满足了自己曾经的幻想，让人很想细细品尝一番——"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":10,"text":"“舔。”"}],"coverage":{"through":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":66},"chapters":[1,2],"material":"complete","semantic":"partial","gaps":["未提供当前阅读范围与视角专属的语义缺口说明。"],"recordsExhausted":false,"corpusClosed":false},"completeness":{"recordsExhausted":false,"corpusClosed":false,"matchingRecords":40,"returned":10},"truncation":{"page":true,"depth":false,"unavailableReferences":0},"nextCursor":"eyJ2ZXJzaW9uIjoxLCJxdWVyeSI6IjY2MjMwOTdhNDUzNDY3OGM0YTYyNjJlYWQ3ZjMyOTg3ZTJmMzAxNTMxMmE1MzIzNGQ3ZDVmYzZkMjUxMzM3ZDciLCJvZmZzZXQiOjEwLCJjaGVja3N1bSI6ImY0ZDYwNmE5NzZhYWJlZmE0M2MyMDhiZTllOTE0OTZlODA5OTQ4MDk0YzI1NmZmNjlmNmE3ZTA5MGU4NTA0ZDkifQ"}]}]}
